'''Dhum''' was a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] owned by the [[Singing Mountain Clan]]. He was the brother of [[Ichor (rancor)|Ichor]] and fought in the [[Battle of Dathomir (Hunt for Zsinj)|Battle of Dathomir]].<ref name="CTD" />
